use_case_summary: Primary product-facing chat + embeddings for in-app help, plus nightly reranking for personalization and search relevance. Embeddings used for vector search; chat for contextual help and code hints.
requirements: Latency: p95 < 250ms for standard chat flows; p99 targets for long contexts accepted up to 500ms during batch windows
Throughput: sustained peak 50 RPS with bursts up to 120 RPS; nightly batch rerank jobs (10k requests over 1 hour)
Cost sensitivity: medium-high; prefers committed pricing to cap variable spend
Model preferences: open models preferred (quantized variants), but will accept small commercial models as fallback during incidents
Routing/fallback: cross-region fallback to us-west if us-east capacity constrained; auto-fallback to quantized variant for cost control
Data residency: US-only for PII subsets; control plane may be in Redwood hosted
poC_results: Hosted API latency p90 ~120ms for short chat flows (prompt + generation)
Embeddings batch throughput ~8k vectors/hr on hosted PoC configuration
Cost: PoC observed ~0.35x internal cost projection for typical chat traffic mix
Reliability: Hosted fallback worked in 1 simulated AZ failure during test
pricing_discussion: Customer prefers committed tokens vs per-inference billing — requested 3-tier commit quote (0.5M / 1.5M / 3M tokens/month)

Ramp schedule proposed by customer: 25% month1, 50% month2, 75% month3, 100% month4

Overage: customer requests soft overage rate (significant discount off on-demand) with hard cap at 20% of committed monthly tokens; Redwood to propose specific $/M token overage rate

SLA: customer requests latency SLA credits specific to Dedicated (will trade additional discount for tighter SLOs)
